Terms of service

The rules for playing PolyGolf.

Using the game

PolyGolf is provided by the Room310 × OneShotStudios team at littlelinks.study and polygolf.lol. These terms apply when you use the game. Last updated: October 4, 2026. Questions: room310support@gmail.com.

Accounts

You must be at least 13 to create an account or use online community features. If you are under the age of legal majority where you live, have a parent or guardian review these terms with you. Choose a suitable username and a password of at least six characters. You are responsible for keeping your account secure. Do not impersonate others or share accounts to evade restrictions. Accounts do not require an email address, so recovery may be limited if you lose your credentials.

Fair play and community

Do not cheat, exploit bugs for rewards, attack the service, automate abusive requests, manipulate rankings, harass other players, or upload unlawful, hateful, sexually explicit or infringing content. Report bugs and harmful content through the contact page. We may remove content or restrict accounts for abuse; you may contact support to ask for a review.

Coins, items and Country Club

Coins and virtual items are game features, have no cash value, and cannot be redeemed or traded for money. Earned coins can buy eligible items, lockers and the Country Club membership. Membership currently costs 50,000 coins and unlocks at level 10. The Founders pass has 30 tiers unlocked through play. Locker contents and rarity probabilities are available before opening; duplicates may occur. Features, prices, balances and rewards may change as we develop the game. We aim to preserve legitimate progress but cannot promise that every feature will remain available indefinitely.

Item trading

You may exchange eligible in-game items with accepted friends. Offers specify the exact items and patterns on each side, expire after 24 hours, and require the recipient’s approval. Review an offer before accepting: completed exchanges are final within the game. Country Club, starter, level, code, rank and achievement rewards are excluded. Trading does not support money, cash-out or external payments.

Real-money previews

The $5.99 membership and coin-pack prices are previews only. All real-money purchase controls currently display “Coming Soon.” There is no checkout, charge, subscription or payment processing. Any future paid offering will explain its price and applicable purchase terms before you can buy.

Your creations

You keep rights you hold in your uploaded pictures, biographies and maps. By submitting them, you give us permission to store, display and distribute that content as needed to operate the game and community features. Only upload content you have permission to use. You can contact us about removal; cached copies and backups may take time to disappear.

Our content

The game’s original code, artwork, branding and other materials belong to their respective creators or licensors. You may play the game and share gameplay screenshots or videos with credit. This does not grant permission to sell our assets, imply endorsement, or redistribute third-party material contrary to its license. Third-party notices appear on the copyright page.

Availability and responsibility

The game is under active development and is provided as available. Bugs, downtime, data loss or changes may occur. To the extent permitted by applicable law, we do not promise uninterrupted service or fitness for a particular purpose and are not responsible for indirect losses resulting from use of the game. Nothing in these terms removes rights or remedies that cannot lawfully be excluded.

Changes and contact

We may revise these terms and publish an updated date. Significant new paid features will be explained before purchase. You can stop using the game at any time and request account deletion through room310support@gmail.com.
